# Snowfield & Jordan Masopust

> Applied AI implementation, custom multi-model workflows, and operational enablement built inside accounts you own.

## Studio Overview

Snowfield is a remote, nationwide applied AI implementation studio founded by Jordan Masopust, serving established US businesses and remote product or operations teams. Before writing a single prompt, Snowfield audits what breaks in the operation: contradicting playbooks, tribal escalation rules, and messy source data. Once the reference layer holds up, we build custom workflows across Claude, Gemini, and OpenAI with Python and React tooling, lean context budgets, and independent cross-model review checks so tools flag gaps when they do not know instead of inventing an answer.

Every prompt, GitHub repository, and guide deploys straight inside accounts the client already owns, paired with live team onboarding so staff can update rules without calling an agency.

## Current Capabilities

- **Custom Operational Assistants:** Multi-model assistants routed across Claude, Gemini, and OpenAI with lean context design, strict retrieval guardrails, and refusal gates.
- **Structured Knowledge Systems:** Playbook audits, Knowledge-Centered Service (KCS) architecture, and clean operational reference layers.
- **Role-Based Onboarding Web Apps:** Interactive onboarding, training, and live-call operator web apps built in React and Python for non-technical staff under live production pressure.
- **Cross-Model Verification Pipelines:** Routing and independent cross-model review checks with local state, audit trails, and strict grounding gates.

## Founder Track Record (Jordan Masopust)

Firsthand operational builds. Hands-on with language models since GPT-3 in July 2020.

- **Regulated Lending Workflow Assistant:** Architected a multi-model loan-officer workflow assistant across Claude and Gemini with rules that make it refuse rather than guess when guidance is missing, paired with a setup guide and rollout proposal corporate IT adapted company-wide.
- **High-Volume B2B Sales Enablement:** Built a multi-model discovery and objection copilot while on a high-volume business-to-business sales team, alongside a repeatable live-transfer process adopted at the director level.
- **Enterprise Restaurant Point-of-Sale Support & Knowledge-Centered Service:** Team lead on a 24/7 enterprise restaurant point-of-sale support team of more than fifty agents serving over a thousand restaurant concepts. Audited more than half of the knowledge base and turned recurring engineering fixes into standard troubleshooting playbooks. Built a structured case-dispatching workflow alongside Dynamics 365 and Jira to speed first replies and cut repeat callbacks.

## Technical Stack

Claude, Gemini, OpenAI, AI-assisted Python and React web apps, Dynamics 365, Jira, and Knowledge-Centered Service (KCS).
